verdict.rationale: Brex publishes per-API reference pages (e.g., Transactions, Budgets, Payments) and an official Postman developer workspace with collections for all its APIs that users can fork and run. However, no in-browser interactive 'try it' console in the reference itself is evidenced, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs request console, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: go to the Brex developer workspace which has collections for all of the Brex APIs. You can fork the collection into your own workspace
The transactions API lets you view your transactions, accounts, and statements.
The payments API allows you to initiate and manage payments and vendors from your Brex business accounts.
